issues.where: right and lower-right planet limb (pair-02-b.png tiles E, G, H)
issues.what: a dark blue-black gap separates the sunlit cloud deck from a detached thin cyan outer rim, and the top limb shows a double concentric line instead of a single continuous glow
issues.fix: close the gap between the planet surface and atmosphere shell and blend the limb scattering into one smooth, continuous outward falloff matching pair-01-a.png

issues.where: lower-center terminator across the planet disc (pair-02-b.png tiles A, I)
issues.what: the shadow transition breaks into jagged, posterized dark-teal and black blotches, and grazing sunlit cloud tufts along the terminator look dim and greenish
issues.fix: remove the quantized shadow banding so the terminator grades smoothly from deep blue into black, and restore crisp warm-white grazing light on the low terminator cloud tops

issues.where: ring system, especially lower-left foreground arc over the dark disc and lower-right loop (pair-02-b.png tiles D, H)
issues.what: the crisp multi-stranded ringlets and bright clumpy ring arcs crossing the lower-left dark hemisphere are smeared into a single blurry, featureless grey band
issues.fix: sharpen the individual concentric ring strands and restore the distinct bright foreground ring arcs across the lower-left hemisphere

issues.where: upper-left horizon limb (pair-04-b.png tiles B, I)
issues.what: the blue atmospheric glow stops in a hard crisp edge right at the geometric horizon with almost no outer haze fading into space
issues.fix: widen and soften the outer atmospheric falloff above the upper-left limb so it matches the smooth blue haze of pair-03-a.png across the full horizon

issues.what: the moon loses its pale cyan mid-latitude band and smooth pinkish-tan polar gradient, appearing uniformly chalky grey-pink with coarser dark spots and a clockwise-rotated terminator that puts more of the lower-left pole in shadow
issues.fix: restore the soft pinkish-tan to pale-cyan surface color zoning, soften the albedo markings, and rotate the lighting terminator counterclockwise to illuminate the lower limb as in pair-01-a.png

issues.where: sunlit white cirrus bands near the upper-right limb and storm rim (tiles A, C, E, H)
issues.what: fine wind-sheared white cloud wisps break up into harsh, stippled, aliased white flecks
issues.fix: soften and anti-alias the high-altitude white cloud streaks into smooth, fibrous wisps with feathered edges

issues.where: upper-left planet limb toward the terminator (pair-02-b.png tile B)
issues.what: the soft cyan outer atmospheric haze above the darkened upper-left limb is clipped down to a thin, hard blue edge
issues.fix: extend and soften the faint blue atmospheric glow outward into space along the upper-left limb

issues.where: bright white star in the upper-right sky (pair-04-b.png tile C)
issues.what: the crisp four-point diffraction spikes on the bright white star are softened into a round blur
issues.fix: restore the sharp cross diffraction spikes and pinpoint star core in the upper-right sky
